title: Difficult Conversations
subtitle: How to Discuss What Matters Most
author: Douglas Stone, Sheila Heen, Bruce Patton
description: Dealing with your ex-husband, who can't seem to show up reliably for weekends with the kids; navigating a workplace fraught with office politics or racial tensions; saying "I'm sorry" or "I love you". We all have difficult conversations, no matter how confident or competent we are. And too often...
